about.menemukanRahasia: Discovering the Secret of Unique Regional Drinks
about.p1: Cerita Meramuda is an Artisan Tea created to revive regional beverages—a premium spice tea product crafted exclusively from high-quality natural ingredients such as flowers, spices, and selected tea leaves.
about.p2: Each Artisan Tea variant is designed to provide a special tea-drinking experience, combining harmonious flavors that are calming and refreshing in every serving. This product emphasizes the authenticity of natural raw materials and handmade production.
about.p3: We are committed to delivering tea that not only delights the palate but also reflects quality and integrity in every step of production.
about.prosesDesc: We believe that a good cup of tea starts with a good process. Therefore, all our products are produced in facilities that meet food safety standards and are Halal certified. From ingredient selection, production, to packaging, every step is carefully done to deliver quality tea that is safe, consistent, and ready to accompany your every moment.
about.hospitalityDesc: Cerita Meramuda presents artisan tea ready to be the choice for hotels, cafes, restaurants, and various hospitality industry players. Crafted from a blend of selected tea, spices, flowers, and natural fruits, each variant is designed to deliver unique flavors, consistent quality, and a memorable tea experience for every guest.
about.momenDesc1: Cerita Meramuda is designed to complement every moment, from breakfast, afternoon tea, to signature beverages. Can be served hot or cold, every artisan tea blend combines selected tea, spices, flowers, and natural fruits to deliver a distinctive flavor character and a different tea experience.
about.momenDesc2: Partner with Cerita Meramuda and deliver a memorable tea experience for every guest.
about.historyP1: Cerita Meramuda (Discovering the Secret of Unique Regional Drinks) is inspired by the richness of Indonesian spices, collaborated with the potential of regional excellence. We believe that every region holds a unique flavor identity. Behind every ingredient lies history, culture, and local wisdom that shapes its uniqueness.
about.historyP2: All our tea and coffee raw materials are sourced from various regions across the archipelago known for their distinctive taste and aroma. This collaboration is not merely a combination of ingredients, but represents identity and a modern interpretation of archipelago flavors. Every tea blend we prepare without machines to deliver a unique taste experience from the first sip.
about.craftedNatureDesc: High-quality natural ingredients from the archipelago's riches.
about.refinedHandDesc: Handmade process without machines for a unique taste.
about.halalDesc: Food safety & halal standards at every production step.
